{{Quote|But there are some among us who, for one reason or another, cannot be of The Flock. No one cares where the winds bear us.|[[Kaird]], to [[Tarnese Bleyd]]|<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>}}
The '''Flock''' was a term used by the [[Nediji]] to describe their planetary society on [[Nedij]]. All Nediji were members of the Flock, although some individuals found that they were not able to meet the standards expected of members of the Flock and were often exiled.
